items.title: Object (Widerspruch) to Kinderzuschlag decision
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei: Familienkasse Musterlahn, Bahnhofsallee 40, 35576 Beispielwetzlar.
items.computation: Letter dated (Bescheid vom) 20.11.2026, a Friday; no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date is stated, so the document date is the posting day. The letter itself states delivery is deemed on the 4th day after posting ('am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post bekannt gegeben'). The Familienkasse acting for Kinderzuschlag is a social-law body governed by § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, so (unlike tax offices) the deemed-delivery day is NOT shifted even if it falls on a weekend/holiday. Counting: 20.11 (Fri) +1=21.11(Sat), +2=22.11(Sun), +3=23.11(Mon), +4=24.11.2026 (Tue) → deemed delivered Tue 24.11.2026. Widerspruch period under § 84 SGG is one month from delivery; the delivery day itself is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) but the period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 24.12.2026 (Thursday). 24.12 is a normal working day in NRW (not a statutory holiday), so no shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 64 Abs. 3 SGG is needed. Final deadline: Thursday, 24.12.2026.
